claims.claim: The paper reports declining verification accuracy and embedding similarity as recordings move farther apart in time, with age and gender affecting the rate of change.
claims.limitations: Speaker coverage, language balance, recording channels, gated data, and longitudinal confounding limit causal claims about biological aging.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved ICBHI performance and more patient-balanced behavior with the proposed alignment losses.
claims.limitations: Patient/device distribution, benchmark labels, acoustic conditions, and absent clinical deployment evaluation limit medical interpretation.

claims.claim: The paper reports a structured template intended to make subjective speech-synthesis studies more reproducible and limitations more visible.
claims.limitations: A checklist cannot guarantee participant representativeness, perceptual validity, or exact replication when access differs.

claims.claim: The paper reports gains across semantic and temporal metrics and user preference, with prompt/time components supported by ablations.
claims.limitations: Automatic proxies, dataset distribution, event taxonomy, and a small listener study limit claims about real-world Foley usefulness.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved caption scores and a favorable multi-layer codebook tradeoff.
claims.limitations: Reference-caption variability, language bias, metric disagreement, and no independent human grounding study limit claims.

claims.claim: The paper reports lower localization error in most tested reverberant scenarios and improved robustness.
claims.limitations: Array geometry, source count, room conditions, harmonic assumptions, and angular-error averaging limit transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports AdaBoost at 0.89 accuracy and 0.67 F1 against 0.77 baseline, plus a 39-participant usability survey with 82% high engagement.
claims.limitations: Cohort composition, task design, leakage risk, self-report, and absent clinical validation limit health claims.

claims.claim: The paper reports stronger semantic resilience under mismatch, with both modules contributing.
claims.limitations: Synthetic shuffle may not represent real errors; caption variability and proxy metrics limit human-grounding claims.
